# Route of the Dunes

> Route of the Dunes (routeofthedunes.com) is a small-group and private Sahara desert tour operator running trips from Marrakesh and Fes to Erg Chebbi (Merzouga). The site offers a 3-day Marrakesh loop and a 5-day Fes-to-Marrakesh crossing, with shared, standard private, and luxury private pricing tiers, plus a Journal of 27+ first-hand planning guides (costs, packing, safety, camp comparisons, itineraries) and a full French version of the site. Booking is by inquiry form, WhatsApp, or email — quotes are custom, no instant checkout.

## Core routes

- [Homepage](https://routeofthedunes.com/): routes, itineraries, pricing tiers, and booking
- [Version française](https://routeofthedunes.com/index-fr.html): the full site in French
- [3-Day Marrakesh Desert Tour](https://routeofthedunes.com/#itinerary-3day): Marrakesh → Atlas → Erg Chebbi → Marrakesh loop
- [5-Day Fes to Marrakesh Crossing](https://routeofthedunes.com/#itinerary-5day): the full route through the dunes and kasbahs
- [Pricing Tiers](https://routeofthedunes.com/#pricing): shared group vs private standard vs private luxury
- [Activities](https://routeofthedunes.com/#activities): camel trekking, quad, buggy, sandboarding

## Journal index

- [All planning guides](https://routeofthedunes.com/journal.html): the complete journal with category filters
